subject.title: Auto-apply safe doctor fixes on gateway start

question: Which doctor repair subset, if any, may the Gateway apply on startup without an explicit operator command?
rationale: Current startup intentionally does not write config, while the issue discussion shows unattended doctor repair can cross sandbox, channel availability, and security-sensitive config boundaries.

options.title: Design a narrow startup repair subset
options.body: Allow only idempotent migrations with explicit logging and skip channel/provider/security toggles unless a maintainer-approved opt-in policy exists.

options.title: Keep startup repair manual-only
options.body: Leave Gateway startup as validate-and-hint, and rely on `openclaw doctor --fix` or supervisor preflight commands for all config writes.

options.title: Add a broad auto-fix option
options.body: Expose an opt-in startup repair setting, but accept the compatibility and security review burden for every repair action it can trigger.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow startup repair subset
recommendation.body: Allow only idempotent migrations with explicit logging and skip channel/provider/security toggles unless a maintainer-approved opt-in policy exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for doctor repair/write boundaries points to the doctor config-flow extractions and related repair work authored by vincentkoc.
